llm_response.reason: The website claims to be a Dutch online fashion store but lacks all legitimate business identifiers: it does not provide any physical address, verified business email, or phone number on the contact page—only a generic form is present (scam char #4, #6). It uses trust-building and urgency tactics ('100% Safe shopping,' 'Hot Sale Offer') (scam char #3, #13). The privacy policy is only mentioned in a footer link and cannot be immediately inspected. Such behavior, combined with generic product offers and ambiguous information, strongly matches the profile of a fake online shopping scam site.
